title: Uniqueness of Rank-Metric Completions of Bratteli Systems
summary: Let $R$ be a unital ring equipped with a Sylvester matrix rank function $\rk$. A harmonic function $α$ on a Bratteli diagram $B$ defines a weighted matrix rank on the associated algebraic direct limit $A(B,R)$. We prove that, if $α$ is extreme and the total weight of blocks of any fixed bounded size tends to zero, then the rank completion of $A(B,R)$ is isomorphic to $\mathcal M_{R,\rk}$, the rank completion of the direct system $\Mat_{2^k}(R)$ with connecting maps $x\mapsto\diag(x,x)$ and normalized ranks $2^{-k}\rk$.
